text:
sol.design: Quick sync about the batch vectors preview + relevance table — a couple of UX nits from QA and accessibility flagged during the usability pass. Trying to get consensus before I push the next Figma iteration.
tamir.pm: what's the highest priority?
sol.design: 1) export headers and escaping (CSV) — users reported commas/newlines in source text break columns, 2) default sort in relevance table (should it be by score desc or by last-updated?), 3) compact density mode layout causing truncated metadata to lose context for copy/paste.
noah.fe: on CSV: we currently do naive join on commas. I'll switch to RFC4180 quoting and make sure newlines are encoded as "\n" inside quotes. Example header we should produce:
```csv
vector_id,score,source,metadata_tags,embedding_length
v_123,0.87,"Line1\nLine2","customer:acme;type:invoice",1536
```
leah.a11y: please add a column header title attr and aria-describedby for the legend. Also table needs role="grid" and each row should have aria-rowindex, plus a visible focus indicator when using keyboard to traverse rows. Compact mode currently hides focus outline.
sol.design: good call. For sort: PM asks score desc by default so highest relevance shows first, but devs want last-updated for reproducibility in logs. tamir.pm: leaning to score desc — that's what our customers expect for rerank results. We can add a small timestamp column and allow users to persist sort.
noah.fe: implement sortable columns with aria-sort and announce changes via live region. For default sort we can server-side order by score desc and keep client toggle.
leah.a11y: announce when export completes: "Export ready: 42 vectors" and make the download link receive focus, with role="status" update. Also export button needs aria-label that reads the file name, e.g., "Download vectors, 42 rows, CSV".
sol.design: copy tweak: change button text to "Export CSV (vectors)" and in the dropdown add: "Export selected", "Export all", "Export with metadata" to clarify options.
tamir.pm: about compact density: we had feedback that metadata chips collapse without tooltip. If we show truncated text with a tooltip on hover/focus that solves it. But ensure tooltips are accessible via keyboard.
noah.fe: will implement truncation with a \u201clinear-gradient\u201d + \u201ctitle\u201d fallback, and add a \u201caria-label\u201d equal to full metadata string for screenreaders.
leah.a11y: ensure tooltips are reachable via focus (use aria-describedby to link to hidden tooltip content). Test with VoiceOver and NVDA.
ci-bot: automated check: export-smoke-test v1.3 -> PASSED (csv-quoting, row-count match, content-encoding). :white_check_mark:
tamir.pm: timeline? can we get prototype + aria fixes in the next 24h?
noah.fe: I'll open a PR tonight with CSV escaping & aria-grid changes. ETA review tomorrow morning.
sol.design: I'll update Figma to show the sticky right-aligned export button, the dropdown wording, and the tooltip behaviour. Also adding a mini-help text under the table: "Columns: id, score, source, metadata. Toggle Sort to pin your preferred order."
leah.a11y: I'll run a quick keyboard-only walkthrough after the PR and post any follow-ups. If anything major surfaces we'll snapshot for the retro.
tamir.pm: awesome. if all good, we'll ship as part of the next minor release. thanks team! :party_popper:
